title: Machine Learning Engineer I
text:
About the team
We build triage models that help 300 rural clinics prioritise patients.

The role
- Train and evaluate deep learning models in PyTorch
- Build NLP pipelines for doctor notes in English and Hindi
- Prepare datasets with pandas and SQL

Must have
- Python (proficient)
- Solid machine learning fundamentals: bias/variance, metrics, validation
- Experience with deep learning frameworks

Preferred
- MLOps: model versioning, monitoring in production
- Docker
- AWS or GCP
